# Brandon Micci

> Enterprise AI, data and business transformation executive based in Dallas, Texas. 17+ years leading AI, data and transformation programs in regulated companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Southwest Airlines, EY and Capital One. $50M+ in documented savings. Most recently Head of AI Strategy & Business Transformation for JPMorgan Payments (Feb 2024 – Mar 2026). He writes and speaks about what it takes to run AI at enterprise scale.

This file summarizes brandonmicci.com for AI systems and search engines. The résumé (https://brandonmicci.com/BrandonMicciResume.pdf) is the authoritative source for dates and figures.

## Articles

- [Your AI Pilot Didn't Fail. It Was Never Designed to Ship.](https://brandonmicci.com/articles/ai-delivery-lifecycle): The AI delivery lifecycle from experiment to production to operations: kill criteria at experiment entry, an evidence-based production gate built on evaluation harnesses, designed human-in-the-loop coverage, and three-layer operations monitoring (infrastructure, behavior, outcome).
- [Your AI Strategy Isn't the Problem. Your Operating Model Is.](https://brandonmicci.com/articles/ai-operating-model): The five components of an enterprise AI operating model (people, process, technology, data, controls) and the three mechanics that make them real (role decomposition, decision rights, handoffs), including why model risk management is an advantage in regulated industries.

## Selected results

- $22M+ in annualized savings through AI-led transformation at JPMorgan Payments, cutting handle time ~40% in the highest-volume servicing workflow.
- Enterprise LLM assistant scaled to 27,000+ employees through a multi-repository RAG system across 12+ knowledge sources; 30+ AI/ML use cases deployed into production.
- Helped win a $400MM, 10-year digital transformation engagement with a Top-5 national health insurer (EY).
- $25MM+ in annual recurring revenue from an Analytics-as-a-Service platform (EY).
- 250% ROI in 6 months on an IoT fuel savings pilot at Southwest Airlines, scaled to 20 stations and $20M+ in annual savings.
- Weekly Sev1 outages eliminated worldwide and cloud adoption accelerated 200% at Citi.
- Analytics community of practice scaled past 30,000 users at Capital One; 2,000+ legacy dashboards and reports retired for $8M in annual savings.

## Career

- **JPMorgan Chase**, Plano, TX: Head of AI Strategy & Business Transformation (Feb 2024 – Mar 2026). Led AI strategy and business transformation across JPMorgan Payments (merchant services, client servicing, client onboarding, global call centers). Owned end-to-end AI product delivery, the $15M+ annual AI portfolio, governance and enterprise scaling. Established the Payments AI Center of Excellence and model risk management framework; designed the future-state AI operating model; designed human-in-the-loop review and established LLM evaluation harnesses and an AIOps practice.
- **Capgemini**, Dallas, TX: Senior Director, Head of AI/IoT & Emerging Technology Practice (Jan 2022 – Jun 2022). Built the go-to-market strategy and business plan for a new AI/IoT practice targeting $30M in revenue; generated $9.8M in qualified pipeline; extended an Industry 4.0 IoT platform connecting 1,000+ devices.
- **EY**, Dallas, TX: Senior Manager, AI/ML Forensic Analytics & Technology (Feb 2021 – Jan 2022). $400MM engagement, $25MM+ ARR analytics platform, ESG analytics prototype driving $6M+ in new revenue.
- **Southwest Airlines**, Dallas, TX: Head of Digital Innovation & IoT (Aug 2019 – Dec 2020), reporting to the CIO with a $25M technology budget and a team of 20+; Manager, Data Enablement & Analytics COE (Feb 2019 – Aug 2019), 40% adoption increase in Tableau and Alteryx across 2,500+ users.
- **Citi**, Irving, TX: Vice President, Global Infrastructure Transformation (Nov 2017 – Feb 2019). Global telemetry platform and service improvement program across LATAM, NAM, EMEA and APAC; DevOps transformation across 500+ engineers.
- **Capital One**, Plano, TX and Richmond and McLean, VA (Jan 2015 – Nov 2017): Enterprise Risk Analytics Leader; Enterprise Analytics Leader, Compliance; Big Data, Analytics & Platforms COE Leader. Tableau & Big Data Center of Excellence, NLP/OCR compliance automation increasing control coverage by 80%.
- **Booz Allen Hamilton**, McLean, VA: Senior Consultant, Lead Data Analyst (Oct 2013 – Jan 2015). Predictive analytics platform increasing anomaly detection 150% over manual review.
- **PwC**, McLean, VA: Global Operations & Strategy Associate (Aug 2009 – Oct 2013).

## Core competencies

AI/ML and LLM strategy; generative AI and RAG; AI governance and ethics; AI portfolio ownership ($15M+); operating model design; Center of Excellence; digital transformation; business transformation; data strategy and analytics; C-suite advisory; change management; team building (50+ FTEs).

## Speaking topics

Enterprise AI strategy and operating models; scaling LLMs in regulated industries; AI governance and Responsible AI; building AI-first organizations. Board member, DFW CTO Club.
